cover_hook: 1st new penguin species in over 100 years
caption_hook: 🐧 Scientists named the 1st new penguin species in over 100 years, hiding among gentoo penguins + 3 more wins you missed 👇
question: Either/or: secret penguins or 100-year buffalo comeback? 👇
share_line: Send this to the friend who loves penguins
reel_hook: 1st new penguin species in over 100 years
first_comment: Bonus: the reference specimen for the new species was collected in 1897 and has sat in a New York museum ever since. What else is hiding in museum drawers? 🐧

stories.stat_label: years since a new penguin was named
stories.headline: Gentoo penguins were secretly 4 species, and 1 is brand new
stories.summary: Reading the genomes of 64 gentoos from 10 colonies, scientists found 4 separate species. One, the southeastern gentoo of the remote Kerguelen Islands, is new to science.
stories.why: Naming each species helps protect the ones most at risk from warming seas.

stories.stat_label: years since wild buffalo lived here
stories.headline: Wild buffalo are back in an Indian state after about 100 years
stories.summary: 8 wild buffalo, 6 females and 2 males, travelled ~2,200 km from Kaziranga and now roam a 17-hectare enclosure in Kanha Tiger Reserve. The goal: 50 animals in 3 years.
stories.why: Big grazers keep grasslands and wetlands healthy for everyone else.

stories.stat_label: ring of trees planned around London
stories.headline: Volunteers will plant a 200 km ring of trees around London
stories.summary: The London Tree Ring invites schools and community groups to plant and care for a green corridor over 25 years. Pilots already planted 1,500 trees, including rare disease-resistant elm.
stories.why: Cooler streets, more wildlife, and neighbours who watch their trees grow.

stories.headline: A teen lay in the dirt to win with a dung beetle photo
stories.summary: Oscar Whitfield shot a dung beetle rolling its ball at eye level, flat on the ground. It won Young Wildlife Photographer of the Year in a contest with a record 65,403 entries.
stories.why: Patience and a low angle turned a tiny beetle into a winner.

fun_fact: Before this, the last new penguin species was named in 1921: the northern rockhopper.
